name: reactor-next-2-load-sequence
description: #77: the field-loaded condition for #38. From after-battle, walk up-left until g_FieldCurrentMap differs from 0x74; then, with no input, until g_IsFieldLoading leaves 2 (load_start: frames after the ID change) and until it reads 2 again (load_done). At the end: field mode, the field ID is md1_1 (0x75) and g_IsFieldLoading reads 2, so "field mode, a valid field ID and g_IsFieldLoading = 2" marks a loaded field. map_save and prev_field are reported to see when the savemap copy follows.

game_state.description: g_GameState (s16 as u16; confirmed #76): field 1. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) symbols.main.us.txt

map_cur.description: g_FieldCurrentMap (s16 as u16): the field ID (#77). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) symbols.main.us.txt, include/game.h

map_save.description: Savemap (0x8009C6E4, Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) include/game.h) + 0x0B96 current_location_id (ff7-flat-wiki Savemap)

prev_field.description: g_FieldState (0x8009ABF4) + 0x64 prevFieldId. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) include/game.h FieldState

loading.description: g_IsFieldLoading (s16 as u16): 2 in a settled field, 1 shortly after a map change (#77 attempts 1-2). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) symbols.main.us.txt
